verdicts.reason: The two candidates share the same layout and the same flaws. The 'NEW FLAVOR' badge has shrunk to unreadable size and been moved below the CTA, sitting on a decorative circle. The oversized CTA pill crowds the subhead and collides with the background circles. The brand lockup is tiny and pushed into the top-right corner. A breaks the headline as 'Chase / the Light', which keeps the gold 'the Light' phrase together. B breaks it as 'Chase the / Light', which splits the two-colour phrase and leaves 'Light' alone on its own line, so B's typography is worse.
